# Repository guidance

Use `/AGENTS.md` as the authoritative project instructions. Before proposing or changing code, read the canonical document for the affected product, architecture, domain, synchronization, or roadmap area. Do not invent commands that are not yet defined in the repository.

For every user-interface implementation or review, first read `/.agents/skills/apple-design/SKILL.md` and `/docs/UI_DESIGN.md`. Apply the skill as interaction guidance while preserving the industrial clarity and accessibility requirements in the project UI document.
